notes.title: BIG v8.5 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just spent a week going through the game and squishing extra bugs and little annoyances to ensure that THIS is the ultimate version!

So if you're new to the game and just purchased it in the Steam Summer Sale, update asap and enjoy!

Thanks to you all for your support!

James Lightfoot Bros

notes.title: Update v8.1 - a few more niggles ironed out!
notes.notes:
Well, strike me down with a feather but I think this is the ultimate version of Woolley!

BUGS SORTED

[list]
[*] All save loads issues where re-instantiation of objects and hotspots could sometimes appear. 
[*] A plethora if tiny bugs that had crept in, art and animations
[*] After Options menu the Player would get stuck
[/list]

Hope this improves your experience of Woolley Mountain, let me know if you find any issues!

Thanks again

James Lightfoot

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - BUG KILLERS!
notes.notes:
HI, I was recently alerted to some minor and major bugs in the game, which I have taken swift action and hunted them down and killed them all! So thank you for your patience, and please update your game and play play play! 

Your playing experience should be lovely now, so sorry again, and if you fancy leaving a REVIEW at any opint if you haven't before please go ahead!

BUGS KILLED

[list]
[*] Hotspots and items reappearing on scene re entry
[*] Getting stuck after completing the Prison scene
[*] No dialogue audio in Bertie's Lair
[*] Other little bits
[/list]

Anyways, sorry again! And ENJOY

(please shout if I have missed anything though!)

James x

notes.title: Update notes for Patch Nov 22
notes.notes:
The new patch sorts lots of little bugs and tweaks that have been 'bugging' me over the past 12 months!

PLUS

[list]
[*] A horrible gremlin got in at some point and caused loading times to be very SLOOOOOW as the game progressed, so that is now sorted
[*] Options menu is more fluid and bugless
[*] Esc is now Pause as well as using the Options menu
[*] More dialogue click throughs where they were not before
[/list]

Thanks everyone!

ENJOY

notes.title: Big update! Now in Polish and on Linux!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are delighted to announce that Woolley Mountain is now on LINUX! Sorry it’s taken so long! But it’s finally available so get involved and enjoy!

We have also translated the game into Polish, to join the other list of languages- English, Spanish, German and Simplifed Chinese!

There’s also been some bug fixes too, so hopefully you’ll now have an even better experience in this otherworldly adventure! 

So there you have it, enjoy and spread the word!

Thanks!

James Lightfoot

X

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE / SPANISH, GERMAN & SIMPLIFIED CHINESE ADDED / COMING TO MOBILE!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Ladies and gentlemen![/b][/h2]

[h1]A brand new update featuring:[/h1]

3 new languages - Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese!

Updated visuals to ensure multilingual play!

Little bugs fixed and tweaked

This is all to make the game better and of course this big push and update is to coincide with the release of Woolley Mountain on mobile platforms too which is out today!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33321023/aabbb65184913992b638bc8a9ee44c31d194884a.gif[/img]

So, tell your friends, and get hold of it on the phone also!

IOS: https://tinyurl.com/AppleWoolley

ANDROID: https://tinyurl.com/GoogleWoolley

[b]Here is the sales spiel![/b]

After selling over 40,000 units on Nintendo Switch, we are delighted to announce that The Mystery Of Wooley Mountain is being ported to mobile via our amazing partners Bumblebee Interactive and released to the world on May 13! With the help of the ever wonderful Huey Games, we have updated the game to include three new languages! Yep, the game has been translated to Spanish, German and Simplified Chinese!

Woolley Mountain is perfect for your little pocket computer, and looks, sounds and plays brilliantly on the small screen! We cannot wait for you to play it, so please order now to help us get the biggest exposure on the Apple and Google Play stores!

So there you go! Very exciting times for the world of Woolley Mountain!!!

notes.title: BIG NEW UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[b]Very excited to launch V3 update for Woolley Mountain! 
[/b]
The game is being ported to mobile in May, so I have updated and tweaked many things to ensure an even better playing experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33321023/d41d012c63a0cf85a8efdb59c4dc04b4bcbc20e4.png[/img]

* Faster loading times between scenes

* Bigger inventory to ensure ease of finding, using and combining items

* Tweaks and updated art 

* Certain character animations improved

* Lots of tiny amends that bugged this here dev!

* Flash hotspot on screen button

« Comms conversation bug fixed

« Train Station characters not always appearing bug fixed

Enjoy folks

Stay safe and be good!

James Lightfoot
